title: Null control: Hormuz crossref share -> BAS.DE
hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Null control: Crossref Hormuz publication share (not raw counts) 20d z-score > 1 leads BAS.DE returns by 5 days (-); if share also fails the crossref->BASF gas-fear channel is dead [research.hormuz.crossref_share -> finance.BAS.DE.log_return] (parent: R2-0030)
message: Null control confirms channel dead: hormuz crossref_share z>1 -> short BAS.DE fails (r=0.06 n=81, hit 22%, 9 trades, excess -0.36%, OOS 0/2; validity 0, actionability 0). Crossref->BASF gas-fear channel not supported.

trade_idea.entry_rule: research.hormuz.crossref_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short BAS next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
